records.parent_link_note: Synthetic assumption: the official syllabus lists B.TECH-IT and M.TECH-IT under U.V. Patel College of Engineering, Faculty of Engineering & Technology, but names no department. DEPT-IT-001 is a CampusMate demo entity.
records.overview: The Department of Information Technology (DEPT-IT-001) is a synthetic demo department created for CampusMate testing. It hosts the B.Tech IT programme (PROG-BTECH-IT-001) and the M.Tech IT programme (PROG-MTECH-IT-001), whose curricula are taken from the official GUNI structured syllabus, and it operates ten demo laboratories and ten shared facilities in the fictional Demo Academic Block A and Demo Innovation Block B.
records.vision: To be a demo department whose teaching, laboratories and student services are fully discoverable through a trustworthy, citation-first AI assistant.
mission: Deliver the B.Tech IT and M.Tech IT curricula with strong laboratory practice.
Guide every capstone and major project through documented, fair evaluation.
Keep policies, notices and schedules published as versioned, machine-readable records.
Encourage applied research in AI, data, security, cloud and IoT.
